crossRefs.note: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

translations.web: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.
translations.bsb: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away.
translations.kjv: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
translations.asv: And when they heard it, they marvelled, and left him, and went away.
